GUILD_MODULE.CHORES.DESC: A rota that shares the work out by weighted effort rather than by turn
CHORES.MODULE_OFF_TITLE: This house doesn't run a rota
CHORES.MODULE_OFF_BODY: The Chores module is switched off for this server, so there is nothing to show here. Someone with Manage Server can turn it on in the modules settings — there is no override, not even for the owner.
CHORES.FORBIDDEN_BODY: The server refused. Either the Chores module is off for this house, or you don't have access to this channel.
CHORES.EMPTY_BODY: Add a chore with a cadence and an effort weight, and the server starts generating whose turn it is. You never add a turn by hand.
CHORES.NO_TURNS: No turns fall in this window yet. The server generates them from each chore's cadence.
CHORES.SERVER_GENERATES: Turns are generated by the server from each chore's cadence. Nothing here creates one.
CHORES.DELETE_CONFIRM: Delete "{{title}}"? Its turns go with it, including any still outstanding.
CHORES.SKIPPED_HINT: Skipped, not done. Nothing was credited, so the work is still owed — which is why the rota hands the next turn back to the same person.
CHORES.UNKNOWN_ROLE: a role that no longer exists
CHORES.SKIP_TOOLTIP: Skip — the work stays owed and nothing is credited
CHORES.SWAP_TOOLTIP: Pass it on to whoever in the rota has done the least
CHORES.SWAP_NOBODY_BODY: There is no one else in this chore's rotation. Add someone to the rotation role — or switch the chore off a fixed assignee — and it can be passed on.
CHORES.BALANCE_EXPLAINER: Weighted minutes over the last 30 days, against the house average. The next turn goes to whoever is furthest behind their share, not to whoever is next in line.
CHORES.BALANCE_EMPTY: Nothing has been completed in the last 30 days.
CHORES.FORM_EFFORT_HINT: The fairness weight. This is what the rota counts, so a 5-minute job never balances a 40-minute one.
CHORES.FORM_GRACE_HINT: How long past due before it counts as overdue.
CHORES.FORM_ROTATION_HINT: Everyone holding the role is in the pool.
CHORES.FORM_FIXED_HINT: No rotation, and nothing to pass it on to.
CHORES.FORM_ASSIGNMENT_REQUIRED: Pick a rotation role or a fixed assignee — a chore needs one of the two.
CHORES.FORM_ASSIGNMENT_EXCLUSIVE: Pick one or the other, not both.
DECISIONS.EMPTY_BODY: Open a decision when the house needs to agree on something. Everyone can support an option, abstain, or object with a reason.
DECISIONS.MODULE_OFF_TITLE: This house doesn't do house votes
DECISIONS.MODULE_OFF_BODY: The Decisions module is switched off for this server, so there is nothing to show here. A server manager can turn it on in the server's modules settings.
DECISIONS.FORBIDDEN: You can't see the decisions in this channel. That may be a channel permission, or the Decisions module being switched off for this server.
DECISIONS.AWAITING_RESOLUTION: Past its closing time — the result lands within a few minutes.
DECISIONS.RESULT.DECIDED: Carried — quorum was met and nobody objected.
DECISIONS.RESULT.BLOCKED: Every option was objected to, so nothing was carried. Not agreeing is a result too — resolve the objections and open a new decision.
DECISIONS.RESULT.EXPIRED: Closed without reaching quorum. Not enough people voted; abstentions never counted toward it.
DECISIONS.OBJECTIONS_HINT: An objection isn't a downvote. Whatever it names can't be carried until it's resolved.
DECISIONS.OPTION_BLOCKED_HINT: This option can't be carried while the objection stands, however many people support it.
DECISIONS.ONE_VOTE_HINT: You get one vote. Voting again replaces the one you already cast.
DECISIONS.BLOCK_EXPLAINER: An objection stops this being carried on its own — nobody can outvote it. Say why, so the house has something it can actually answer.
DECISIONS.REASON_REQUIRED: A reason is required. An objection nobody can read the reasoning for just leaves the house stuck.
DECISIONS.QUORUM_HINT: How many people have to vote for the result to count. Abstentions don't count toward it.
DECISIONS.CLOSES_AT_HINT: Leave empty to keep it open until someone closes it. Otherwise the result lands within a few minutes of this time.

QUIET_HOURS.WRAPS_MIDNIGHT: This window runs overnight, through midnight.
QUIET_HOURS.TIME_ZONE_DESC: The flat's wall clock. Quiet hours follow it through daylight saving.
QUIET_HOURS.CURRENTLY_QUIET: The house is in quiet hours right now.
QUIET_HOURS.CURRENTLY_AWAKE: The house is not in quiet hours right now.
QUIET_HOURS.DEFERRAL_NOTE: Chore reminders that would fire inside the window are held until it ends. Nothing else is silenced.
QUIET_HOURS.ERROR.SAME_START_AND_END: The start and end must differ.
QUIET_HOURS.ERROR.UNKNOWN_TIME_ZONE: That is not a time zone we recognise. Try Europe/Zurich.
GUEST_ACCESS.TITLE: Guest access
GUEST_ACCESS.DESC: Hand someone a role that ends on its own — the pet sitter's five days finish without anyone remembering to revoke them.
GUEST_ACCESS.NO_ROLES: Create a role first; guests are given an existing role for a while.
GUEST_ACCESS.NO_ACTIVE: No guests hold this role right now.
GUEST_ACCESS.ENDED_NOTE: These no longer grant anything. The rows are cleared away about a week after they lapse.
GUEST_ACCESS.NEEDS_PERMISSION: You need the Manage Guests permission to hand out or end guest access.
GUEST_ACCESS.LAPSES_NOTE: Access stops at the end of the period on its own. You can end it sooner.
GUEST_ACCESS.ERROR.BAD_DURATION: Guest access can last at most one year.
MOVE_OUT.TITLE: Move {{name}} out?
MOVE_OUT.BODY: {{name}} will be removed from the house. Their unfinished chores move to whoever is next, and anything they were assigned on a list is unassigned.
MOVE_OUT.KEEPS_HISTORY: Chores they already did stay on the record — removing them would change everyone else's balance.
MOVE_OUT.WRITE_OFF_EXPLAINER: Writing it off does not move any money. It records that the house has agreed to stop counting the debt, and it is written to the audit log.
MOVE_OUT.CHORES_TO_RESOLVE: {{paused}} chore(s) paused and {{dropped}} dropped — the house needs to decide who picks them up.
MOVE_OUT.FAILED: Could not move this member out

LEDGER.LOAD_FAILED: The ledger could not be loaded.

LEDGER.BALANCES_HINT: anyone at zero is left out
LEDGER.SETTLE_UP_HINT: The fewest payments that clear the board. Recording one doesn't move any money — it records that someone paid.

LEDGER.SPLIT_EVERYONE_HINT: Stays right when someone moves in or out — the usual choice for rent and bills.
LEDGER.SPLIT_SHARES_HINT: Weights, not money. Two means twice as much as one.
LEDGER.SPLIT_SERVER_HINT: The split is worked out on the server, so the parts always add up to the total.
LEDGER.WAS_EXACT: This expense was entered with exact amounts per person. Saving it here replaces those with an even split.
LEDGER.CURRENCY_WARNING: This relabels every amount in the ledger. It does not convert them — 1234 stays 1234 and only the currency next to it changes.

SCENE.BREADCRUMB.LABEL: Where this scene sits

SCENE.ARCHIVE.NO_MATCH_BODY: Nothing in the archive carries every filter you have set.
SCENE.ARCHIVE.ERROR_BODY: The archive could not be read.
SCENE.ARCHIVE.FOLDER_NO_PARENT: Nothing, keep it at the top
SCENE.ARCHIVE.FOLDER_HAS_CHILDREN: This folder holds folders of its own, so it stays at the top level.
SCENE.ARCHIVE.FOLDER_ERROR: That folder could not be saved
SCENE.ARCHIVE.FILE_ERROR: That scene could not be filed
SCENE.ARCHIVE.TAG_ERROR: That tag could not be saved
SCENE.ARCHIVE.TAG_LIMIT: A guild can have {{count}} tags. Delete one to add another.
SCENE.ARCHIVE.MODERATED_HINT: Only people who manage scenes may apply this tag
SCENE.ARCHIVE.OPEN_ERROR: That scene could not be opened
SCENE.ARCHIVE.OPEN_ERROR_DETAIL: Its channel is not in this server any more, or you cannot see it.
SCENE.ARCHIVE.DELETE_FOLDER_HINT: The scenes on this folder are kept. Any folders inside it move to the top level.
SCENE.ARCHIVE.DELETE_TAG_HINT: This takes the tag off every scene that carries it. There is no undo.
SCENE.ARCHIVE.REORDER_ERROR: That folder could not be moved

SCENE.ARCHIVE.TRUNCATED: Showing the first matches only. Narrow the filter to see the rest.
SCENE.TOAST.CREATED_NOT_FILED: The scene was created, but it could not be filed
